verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an accuracy guarantee, indemnification, or audit-support commitment when a Stripe Tax calculation is wrong. The cited docs cover calculation, the taxability_reason field, reports, and TaxJar filing, which are adjacent features and not a vendor guarantee. Accuracy guarantees are a fair axis for a tax-calculation product, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the vendor stands behind its numbers — a documented accuracy guarantee or audit support commitment if a calculation it produced turns out wrong
